doc.title: Will Shade and Dewey Corley Interview, 1960-05-25

title: Scarce work and the police running musicians off the street
summary: Shade says work has fallen off to scuffling, and that police now stop street playing though they once earned good money in a few hours.

story.theme_name: Making a living: hard times, day jobs and scarce work
story.community_name: Day jobs: musicians working outside music

blocks.x: How long before you think you'd be back here?
It might be a week. It might be three months. You can't tell.
Sometimes it might be a year.
Yeah, that's right.
I started the devil to fix nine that time waiting on you.
Yeah, well, you better not wait on me. I got too many other things to do.
I got you faded, dude.
Yeah. Well, how much have you been working lately?

Oh, been and fell off here. I ain't been doing nothing much. About once every month, just like you said, about once every month, every three months, sometimes twice a week, sometimes no times every week, just everything and went flop. Yeah, ain't nothing here.
Scuffling, huh?
Just scuffling. Don't lie to do that no more. Police run you off the streets. See what the guitar and thing will run you off.
I think that's what they call public relations.
I'm pretty sure it is. Some kind of relation. I'd like to say some other kind of relation, but I forgot I was talking over the right.
Yeah, go ahead.
Something to your relations. Yeah, I'd like to say the damn nation
all the nation.
I'm going to
need some more. All right, a little more wine. But they won't let you get out there and hustle on the street like with your band.

We used to get out there at this time of day we'd make five or six seven million dollars a piece three or four hours. Three or four hours we could run about seven million dollars a piece four, five, six of us sometimes. But the way it is now if you catch me anything out there you're penal form bound.
Penal form bound?

Yeah, that's the same as the White House. That's a young pen tension. See, they couldn't build that pen tension yet because it didn't have enough water around it so they just built a young pen tension. Penal form, that's what they call it.
